event.name: ALL-STAR DEBATE IV
event.nature: National Moroccan university debate competition gathering elite debaters from universities and grandes écoles.

theme.title: THE DECEPTION OF TRUTH: WE ARE ALL FOOLS
theme.subtitle: Truth, Illusion, and the Architecture of Certainty
theme.description: This fourth edition examines whether humanity prefers comforting illusions over difficult truths. Exploring cognitive biases, collective mythologies, perception traps, and the imperative of critical thinking in modern society.

pillars.definition: The fragile, objective reality beneath institutional narratives and collective comfort.
The constructed certainties and comforting fallacies embraced by societies and individuals.
The cognitive lens through which human biases transform facts into conflicting worldviews.

event.tagline: 18 voices. 3 languages. One stage where every certainty is challenged.
event.frenchDescription: Une compétition nationale d'élite réunissant les meilleurs orateurs universitaires du Maroc autour de l'éloquence, de la confrontation intellectuelle et de l'esprit critique.
event.arabicDescription: المناظرة الكبرى التي تجمع نخبة الخطباء الجامعيين في المغرب حول الفكر النقدي، وقوة الحجة، وفن الإقناع.

sections.motion: TH, as the last generation with access to humanity's unaltered history, would erase it and allow future generations to construct their own understanding of the past.
sections.note: This motion is to be treated as a value motion.
sections.context: Exploring historical determinism, collective memory, trauma transmission, and whether historical blank slates liberate or doom future generations.

sections.motion: Cette assemblée croit que les sociétés ont davantage besoin de récits communs que de vérités communes.
sections.note: Débat en langue française sur la cohésion sociale et les mythes fondateurs.
sections.context: Interrogeant la tension entre mythe rassembleur et vérité brute : la cohésion des peuples repose-t-elle sur des fictions partagées ou sur la lucidité faktuelle ?

sections.motion: يؤمن هذا المجلس بأن المجتمعات العربية تعيش في عوالم سياسية متوازية : عالم تحتفي فيه بما ترفضه في واقعها.
sections.note: مناظرة باللغة العربية الفصحى وفق القواعد البرلمانية العالمية.
sections.context: تشريح للمفارقات السياسية والاجتماعية في الفضاء العربي المعاصر بين الخطاب المعلن والممارسة المعاشة.

poi.allowed: Entre la 1ère et la 7ème minute (discours standard uniquement)
